# 44i Digital
> White label digital marketing partner for TV and radio broadcasters, advertising agencies, publishers, and out-of-home groups. Based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. 100% US-based fulfillment.

## What 44i Digital does
- Builds each partner a custom agency website for their market, under the partner's brand
- Fulfills digital campaigns (SEO/AEO, paid search, paid social, programmatic display and video, streaming TV/CTV, streaming audio, geofencing, CRM and event targeting, digital out-of-home, email, reputation, websites, creative) invisibly under the partner's brand
- Trains partner sales teams: weekly live sessions, in-market seminars, and Digital Certification
- Provides Fourge Insights, a proprietary digital audit AEs present in the first client meeting
- Assigns each partner an Account Director, Trainer, and Campaign Manager; joins client calls on request and provides a Senior Digital Strategist for large accounts

## Pricing
- Full details: https://www.44idigital.com/program/pricing/
- Partner Growth Program license: $299/month, month-to-month
- Certified Partner rate: $149/month when 100% of sellers hold Digital Certification
- Media priced wholesale, separately
- Revenue guarantee: license refunded if the program does not produce revenue for partners who complete it
